fieldNotes.facility: H-E-B Temple Retail Support Center, 4750 Wendland Rd — Central Texas distribution hub. Roster coordinates landed correctly inside the campus. A major $200M expansion adding an automated frozen-distribution line was under construction at the time of imagery (large active construction zone on the east half of the campus).
fieldNotes.truckGate: Controlled truck entrance off the campus access road; Street View (2026-04) shows a red overhead gantry sign spanning the entrance driveway (check-in / routing instructions) and green perimeter fencing. truckGate true.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No staffed guard booth resolved at the truck entrance. The overhead gantry sign with instructions is consistent with an automated / remote driver check-in; classified remoteGs true. Medium confidence — a booth was not isolated and the entrance area is partly disturbed by construction.
fieldNotes.preGateStaging: Trailers were observed staged along the public access road outside the gate (Street View 2026-04) — usable pre-gate staging.
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: Wide paved truck yard inside the gate before the docks.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Long dock-door banks on multiple warehouse buildings with trailers backed in; well into 50+ band (estimated ~110). The new expansion building will add more.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Multiple large drop yards with extensive parked-trailer arrays on the west and south of the campus; over 50.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Dock banks on distinct building faces / separate buildings.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Multi-building campus — the existing RSC warehouses plus the new frozen-distribution expansion building.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Edge-of-town industrial park on the outskirts of Temple, with adjacent farmland and undeveloped tracts; classified Rural per the small-city tie-breaker.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide gate apron and access road with unused paved width — room for a dedicated express lane.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur into the property.
fieldNotes.connectivityIssue: Edge-of-town location; cellular coverage likely adequate given the surrounding industrial park, but flagged as inferred.
